title: Feature-bagged rank-average of seeds
spec: Wrap the three tree models in a loop of 3 outer repeats with different seeds (seed, seed+1, seed+2), using LightGBM colsample 0.3 and CatBoost rsm 0.2 as now, and average the rank predictions over repeats. Reduces variance in the ensemble without changing model types. Reduce CatBoost to 300 iterations to stay within time.

title: Rank-based pairwise-friendly LightGBM objective
spec: Replace the LightGBM member with LGBMRegressor using objective='huber' removed and instead use a lambdarank-free approach: fit LGBMRegressor with the rank target but with extra_trees=True, num_leaves 7, n_estimators 1000, learning_rate 0.02, colsample_bytree 0.2. Extra-randomized shallow boosting adds diversity and regularization.

title: Mixed-fingerprint feature-bagged RF with Avalon and RDKit topological FP
spec: Add a separate RF member (500 trees, max_features 0.2) trained on rdFingerprintGenerator.GetRDKitFPGenerator(maxPath=6, fpSize=2048) count fingerprints concatenated with descriptors+ErG. Include its rank predictions in the tree rank average as a fourth member.

title: Random-projection MLP member on ErG+descriptors
spec: Add a member: sklearn MLPRegressor (hidden 128, alpha 1.0, early_stopping True, max_iter 300, random_state seed) on QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal') of descriptors+ErG columns (the first columns before Morgan, n = Xtr.shape[1]-N_BITS), averaged over 3 seeds. Blend as a 15% rank-weight, reducing tree weight accordingly (tree 0.55, ridge 0.3, mlp 0.15).

title: Extra descriptors: Mordred-like autocorrelation and BCUT
spec: Add rdkit descriptors from rdkit.Chem.rdMolDescriptors: CalcAUTOCORR2D (192 dims), and BCUT via Descriptors.BCUT2D (8 dims) as another feature block, after cleaning with nan_to_num, and hstack it between ErG and Morgan. Make sure the Ridge still uses only the last N_BITS columns.

title: Strip salts and keep largest fragment
spec: Add a helper that parses each SMILES, keeps the largest fragment with rdkit.Chem.rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser().choose(mol), and uses that mol in the featurize function. Everything else is unchanged. Falls back to the original mol on exception.

title: Rank-pairwise LightGBM (lambdarank-style) member
spec: Replace the LGBMRegressor with LGBMRanker is awkward; instead add a fourth tree member: LightGBM with objective='huber' is already tried, so use LGBMRegressor with objective='quantile' alpha=0.5, n_estimators 600, learning_rate 0.03, num_leaves 7, colsample_bytree 0.2, min_child_samples 15, on the same features and rank target. Include it in the rank average.

title: Pairwise-difference augmentation of Ridge member
spec: Replace the Ridge member's input with log1p Morgan counts plus standardized descriptors+ErG columns (StandardScaler fit on train, clipped to [-5,5]) scaled by 0.1, concatenated. Use Ridge alpha 10. Test predictions use the same transform. Rank-normalize and blend at 30% as before.

title: Heteroscedastic shrinkage of members toward consensus
spec: After computing the rank-normalized predictions of RF, LGBM and CatBoost, compute consensus c = mean of the three; replace each member prediction with 0.5*p + 0.5*c before averaging is not useful, so instead weight each member by the inverse of its mean absolute deviation from the Ridge rank prediction to form weights (normalized), then blend: 0.7*weighted mean + 0.3*ridge. Keep rank normalization.

title: Kernel power sharpening
spec: Compute K = minmax_kernel(Xtr,Xtr) and the test kernel, then raise both elementwise to the power 2 (K**2) before KernelRidge with alpha=0.5. Elementwise powers of a PSD Gram matrix remain PSD (Schur product). This sharpens similarity toward close neighbors.

title: Tune Ridge blend weight and alpha
spec: In fit_predict, change the final blend from 0.7/0.3 to 0.6*mean(tree preds)+0.4*rank(ridge), and set Ridge alpha to 30. Keep everything else unchanged. Ridge on log1p Morgan counts was a replicated gain, so check whether more weight or stronger regularization helps.

title: Per-member feature subsets: ErG+descriptors only for LGBM
spec: Fit LightGBM and CatBoost on only the descriptor and ErG columns (Xtr[:, :-N_BITS]) and keep the RF on all columns. Keep rank averaging and the Ridge. This makes the members use different features, so their errors are less correlated.

title: Stacked meta-features: kNN-similarity features into the GBMs
spec: Add 3 columns to Xtr and Xte: the mean y of the top-5 minmax-Tanimoto neighbours, the max similarity, and the similarity-weighted mean y over the top-20 neighbours. Compute them from the Morgan counts. For training rows, use leave-self-out neighbours. Feed the augmented matrix to the RF, LGBM and CatBoost members, but not to the Ridge.

title: Stochastic bootstrap by scaffold groups
spec: Bag the three tree members: for each of 5 bags, sample 80% of training Murcko scaffold groups (seeded RandomState) without replacement, fit RF, LGBM and CatBoost (CatBoost 200 iters) on those molecules, and rank-average all bag predictions per member. Keep Ridge on the full data and the 0.7/0.3 blend.

title: Strip salts, keep largest fragment
spec: Add a helper clean(smiles) that parses each SMILES with Chem.MolFromSmiles, uses rdkit.Chem.SaltRemover-free approach: Chem.GetMolFrags(m, asMols=True) and keeps the fragment with most heavy atoms, then returns the mol. Use these cleaned mols in descriptors(), erg() and featurize() (make them accept mols built via the helper). Leave the rest unchanged.

title: Tune KRR alpha lower
spec: Change KernelRidge alpha from 1.0 to 0.3 in fit_predict, keeping everything else the same. Minmax kernel on count Morgan is fairly smooth, so less regularization may help. Pure hyperparameter change.

title: Huber-ized CatBoost with RMSEWithUncertainty-free depth 4
spec: Change the CatBoost member to depth=4, iterations=1000, learning_rate=0.03, l2_leaf_reg=10, loss_function='Huber:delta=0.3', rsm=0.2, keeping thread_count=8 and seed. Everything else unchanged.

title: Gaussian process with learned noise via marginal likelihood
spec: Pick KRR alpha inside fit_predict by inner 5-fold CV over alpha in [0.1,0.3,1,3] on the training kernel matrix, using Spearman on held-out folds (random KFold with seed). Precompute the full train kernel once and slice it. Refit with the best alpha on all training data and predict.

title: Kernel-smoothed target (kNN label averaging)
spec: Before fitting the members, replace the rank target y with 0.8*y + 0.2*(similarity-weighted mean of y over the 5 nearest training neighbours, excluding the molecule itself). Use the minmax Tanimoto similarity on Morgan counts. Fit all members on the smoothed target. Predictions are still ranked as before.

title: LGBM/CatBoost on descriptors+ErG plus 3-seed averaging
spec: In fit_predict, build Xdense = Xtr[:, :-N_BITS] (descriptors+ErG) and use it for LightGBM and CatBoost, while the RF keeps all columns. Also run each of the three models with seeds seed, seed+1, seed+2 (CatBoost 300 iters) and rank-average within each model before the final blend. Keep the 0.7 tree / 0.3 Ridge blend.

title: Ridge on log1p Morgan plus scaled descriptors and ErG
spec: Feed the Ridge member the concatenation of log1p Morgan counts and the descriptor+ErG columns, each column standardized with the train mean/std and clipped to [-5,5], with the descriptor block multiplied by 0.1 so the fingerprint dominates. Keep alpha=10 and the 0.3 blend weight.

title: Staged learning-rate decay for LightGBM
spec: Train LightGBM in two stages. First fit 300 trees at lr 0.05. Then continue with init_model for 400 more trees at lr 0.01, using the callbacks reset_parameter(learning_rate=...) via the sklearn fit callbacks argument. Use descriptor+ErG columns only. Everything else is unchanged.

title: Strip salts and keep largest fragment
spec: Add a helper clean(smiles) that parses each SMILES, uses rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.GetMolFrags(asMols=True) and keeps the fragment with the most heavy atoms, returns a canonical SMILES string (fall back to the original if parsing fails). Apply it to train and test SMILES at the top of fit_predict before all featurization.

title: Blend KRR with descriptor LightGBM by rank averaging
spec: Fit the incumbent KRR and also a LightGBM (400 trees, lr 0.03, 15 leaves, colsample 0.3, subsample 0.8, seed=seed, n_jobs=8) on cleaned RDKit descriptors from descriptors(). Convert each prediction vector to ranks via scipy.stats.rankdata, normalize to 0-1, and return 0.7*KRR+0.3*LGBM.

title: Gaussian process marginal-likelihood alpha selection
spec: Using the minmax kernel K on the training set, choose the KRR alpha by an internal eigendecomposition: compute eigh(K), then for alphas in [0.05,0.1,0.2,0.5,1,2] compute leave-one-out residuals in closed form (e_i = [(K+aI)^-1 y]_i / [(K+aI)^-1]_ii) and pick the alpha with the lowest LOO MSE. Fit the final model with that alpha.

title: Salt stripping and largest fragment
spec: Canonicalize molecules by keeping the largest fragment (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser) and neutralizing before featurization.

title: Monotone target smoothing via kNN-label averaging
spec: Before fitting, replace the rank target y with 0.8*y + 0.2*mean of y over each molecule's 5 nearest training neighbors (excluding itself) by minmax Tanimoto similarity on Morgan counts (use existing minmax_kernel on the count block, set diagonal to -1). Then re-rank to uniform. Fit all members on this smoothed target.

title: Heavy-atom-size stratified rank target
spec: Compute the target ranks within 4 quantile bins of heavy-atom count in the training set, then average that stratified rank with the global rank target at 50/50. Fit all members on the mixed target. Test predictions stay unchanged in form.

title: Random-subspace Ridge bagging
spec: Replace the single Ridge with the mean of 20 Ridge models (alpha 10). Each model is trained on a random 50% of the log1p Morgan columns and a bootstrap 80% of the training rows, drawn from np.random.RandomState(seed). Average their predictions and rank them. Keep the 0.3 blend weight.

title: Sum of Morgan and atom-pair minmax kernels
spec: Compute count atom-pair fingerprints with rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator(fpSize=2048) GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy. Build K = 0.5*minmax_kernel(Morgan) + 0.5*minmax_kernel(AtomPair) for train-train and test-train, and fit KernelRidge(alpha=1.0) on the combined kernel as before.

title: Stacked RF on OOF member predictions plus size features
spec: Compute 5-fold OOF rank predictions on the train set for LGBM and Ridge. Append them as two extra columns to Xtr, and append the matching full-fit test predictions to Xte. Fit the RF member on the augmented matrix. Leave the other members unchanged.

title: Wide random-subspace CatBoost with strong regularization
spec: Replace the CatBoost member's settings with depth 8, iterations 400, lr 0.05, rsm 0.1, l2_leaf_reg 30, random_strength 3, bootstrap_type='Bernoulli', subsample 0.6. Keep the same features. This gives a more regularized, more diverse member for the rank average.

title: Lambdarank-style LightGBM member replacing plain LGBM
spec: Replace the LGBMRegressor with LGBMRanker(objective='lambdarank') trained on integer relevance labels = floor(y*30) (y is the rank target in [0,1]), single query group containing all training rows, label_gain=list(range(31)), lambdarank_truncation_level=len(y), same colsample/subsample/leaf params, 300 trees, lr 0.05. Use its predict output rank-normalized as before.

title: Monotone smoothing: shrink member predictions toward consensus
spec: After computing the ranks of each member prediction, replace each with 0.8*own + 0.2*mean of all members before blending. Also weight the ridge at 0.3 as before. A small regularizing change on the ensemble; it should be a few lines in the loop.

title: Shrink members toward consensus
spec: After computing the per-member rank predictions (RF, LGBM, CatBoost), compute their mean m. Replace each member's prediction with 0.5*p + 0.5*m, then blend with the Ridge as before. Alternatively, use the median of the three ranks in place of the mean for the tree part. Implement the median variant: tree part = np.median(preds, axis=0), then re-rank it.

title: Scaffold-grouped bootstrap per member
spec: For each of RF, LGBM and CatBoost, draw its own bootstrap sample of Murcko scaffold groups from the training set, sampling groups with replacement until about 100% of the molecules are covered. Fit the member on that sample with a different seed per member. Rank-average as before and keep the Ridge member on all the data.

title: Replicate ErG incumbent with tuned Ridge weight
spec: In fit_predict change the final blend from 0.7/0.3 to 0.6 rank-average / 0.4 Ridge, and set Ridge alpha=3.0 (was 10.0). Keep everything else unchanged. Note the Ridge prediction is rank-normalized already; the ensemble mean is of ranks.

title: Add Avalon and RDKit-pattern fingerprint counts to Ridge only
spec: Compute 1024-bit Avalon count fingerprints, using pyAvalonTools.GetAvalonCountFP. Apply log1p and concatenate them with the Ridge input's Morgan log1p counts. Leave tree members unchanged. Keep alpha at 10.

title: Monotone-constrained LightGBM on key descriptors
spec: Replace the LightGBM member with one trained on descriptor+ErG columns, using monotone_constraints on a few physchem descriptors. Constrain MolLogP to +1, and leave all other columns at 0. Keep the other parameters unchanged. This acts as a prior that lipophilicity increases clearance.

title: Combine descriptor-only GBMs, descriptors in Ridge, 3 seeds
spec: In fit_predict, fit LightGBM and CatBoost on only the descriptor+ErG columns (all columns except the last N_BITS), keep the RF on all columns. Feed the Ridge member log1p Morgan counts concatenated with standardized, clipped (to +-5) descriptor+ErG columns. Average each tree model over 3 seeds (seed, seed+1, seed+2), keeping CatBoost at 300 iterations to stay within time. Keep the 0.7/0.3 rank blend.

title: Pseudo-labelling with test molecules
spec: After the first ensemble prediction on the test set, take the 30% of test molecules whose member predictions agree most, measured by the lowest std of the three tree-member ranks. Add them to the training data with their blended rank as the target. Refit the RF and LightGBM members on the enlarged set and re-blend with the original predictions 50/50. Use the existing features.

title: Ridge on random Fourier features of descriptors
spec: Add a member that maps quantile-normal descriptor+ErG columns through sklearn RBFSampler (gamma=1/n_features, n_components=1500, random_state=seed). Fit Ridge alpha 3 on the result against the rank target. Rank-blend it at 15%, taking the weight from the trees.

title: Three-seed averaging on top of descriptor-only GBMs
spec: Run the RF, LightGBM and CatBoost members with seeds seed, seed+1 and seed+2. Fit LightGBM and CatBoost on descriptor+ErG columns only, and let the RF keep all columns. Average the rank predictions within each member first, then across members. Keep the Ridge blend at 0.3. Use CatBoost with 300 iterations to stay inside the time limit.

title: Combine descriptor-only GBMs with descriptors in Ridge
spec: Combine the three best leads in one job. LightGBM and CatBoost are fit on the descriptor+ErG columns only (Xtr[:, :n_desc+n_erg]). The RF keeps all columns. The Ridge input is log1p Morgan counts concatenated with standardized descriptor+ErG columns. Standardize with training mean and std, then clip to [-5, 5]. Keep the 0.7/0.3 rank blend.

title: Stacking-free rank average with a Ridge on member OOF
spec: Fit a second Ridge on the descriptor+ErG columns, clipped and standardized, plus log1p Morgan counts. Use alpha 30, with the descriptor block scaled by 0.5. Replace the single Ridge with the mean of the two Ridge rank predictions. Keep the 0.3 total Ridge weight.

title: Dart boosting for LightGBM
spec: Change the LightGBM member to boosting_type='dart', with drop_rate 0.1, 400 trees, learning rate 0.05, num_leaves 15 and colsample_bytree 0.3. Fit it on descriptor+ErG columns only. Dart gives a different regularization from standard GBDT and may add ensemble diversity. Keep everything else unchanged.

title: Rank-Gaussian feature transform for GBM inputs
spec: Before fitting LightGBM and CatBoost, apply sklearn QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal', n_quantiles=200) to the descriptor+ErG columns. Fit it on the training rows only. Trees are invariant to this transform, so apply the same transformed columns to the Ridge member. Concatenate them with log1p Morgan counts, and scale the descriptor columns by 0.3 to act as stronger regularization. Keep the rest unchanged.
